verses.text: Aaron’s sons Nadab and Abihu each took a fire pan, put fire and incense in it, and offered unauthorized fire before Yahweh—something he never commanded them to do. 🔥
Fire came from Yahweh’s presence, consumed them, and they died there before Yahweh. ⚠️
Moses told Aaron, “This is what Yahweh meant when he said, ‘I’ll show my holiness among those who come near me; all the people will see my glory.’” Aaron stayed silent. 🕯️
Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron’s uncle Uzziel. He told them, “Come over and carry your relatives away from the sanctuary, outside the camp.” 🗣️
They came over and carried them outside the camp in their tunics, just as Moses said. 🕊️

Moses told Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, “Don’t let your hair hang loose or tear your clothes, or you’ll die and Yahweh’s anger will fall on the whole community. But your relatives—all Israel—can mourn the fire Yahweh sent. 😔
“Don’t leave the Meeting Tent entrance, or you’ll die; Yahweh’s anointing oil is on you.” They did what Moses said. 🫙
Then Yahweh spoke to Aaron: 📜
“When you or your sons enter the Meeting Tent, don’t drink wine or strong drink, or you’ll die. This is a lasting rule for every generation. 🚫
“You must know the difference between what is holy and what is ordinary, and between what is unclean and what is clean. ⚖️
“Teach Israel every rule Yahweh gave them through Moses.” 📚
Moses told Aaron and the remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, “Take what’s left of Yahweh’s grain offering made by fire and eat it unleavened beside the altar. It’s most holy. 🍞
“Eat it in a holy place. It’s your share and your sons’ share from Yahweh’s fire offerings; that’s what I was commanded.” 🙏
“You, your sons, and your daughters may eat the presentation breast and contribution thigh in a clean place. They’re your share and your children’s share from Israel’s peace offerings. 🍽️

“They must bring the contribution thigh and presentation breast with the fire offerings of fat, and wave them before Yahweh. These portions belong to you and your children for good, just as Yahweh commanded.” 🙌
Moses carefully asked what happened to the sin-offering goat and found it had been burned. He was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s surviving sons. ⚠️
He said, “Why didn’t you eat the sin offering in the sanctuary? It’s most holy, and Yahweh gave it to you to carry the community’s guilt and make atonement for them. 🗣️
“Its blood wasn’t taken inside the sanctuary. You should have eaten the offering in the holy place, just as I commanded.” 🩸

Aaron answered Moses, “Look, today they brought their sin offering and burnt offering before Yahweh. After everything that happened to me today, would eating the sin offering really have pleased Yahweh?” 😔
When Moses heard Aaron’s answer, he accepted it. 🕊️
